# AHOS (Advanced Hybrid Online Systems)

> AHOS is a digital product studio in Beirut, Lebanon. It designs and builds websites, online stores, mobile apps, custom software and AI automations for founders and businesses in Lebanon, the Gulf, Europe and the United States.

One senior team handles design and engineering together, from the first call to launch. Every project gets a fixed quote in writing after a free 30-minute call, payments are split into milestones, clients own all source code and designs on delivery, and every build includes a 30-day warranty. First replies come within 24 hours. The studio has worked since 2023, has shipped 50+ products, and is rated 5.0 on Trustpilot.

## What AHOS builds

- [Websites](https://ahos.xyz/web-development): business sites and landing pages, fast and built for search.
- [Online stores](https://ahos.xyz/ecommerce-development): Shopify or fully custom stores, including cash on delivery and WhatsApp ordering, common for sellers in Lebanon and the Gulf.
- [Mobile apps](https://ahos.xyz/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps, from design to App Store.
- [Custom software](https://ahos.xyz/custom-software): dashboards, internal tools and SaaS platforms.
- [AI and automation](https://ahos.xyz/ai-development): assistants, chatbots, WhatsApp flows and workflow automation.
- [UI and brand design](https://ahos.xyz/ui-ux-design): interfaces, brand identities and design systems.
- [Web3](https://ahos.xyz/web3): smart contracts and dapp interfaces, on request.

## Typical timelines

- Landing page: 1 to 2 weeks
- Website or online store: 2 to 4 weeks
- Mobile app or custom platform: 6 to 12 weeks

## Selected work

- [Threads Activewear](https://threadsactivewear.com): online sportswear store in Beirut selling original Nike, adidas, On and The North Face, with cash on delivery across Lebanon.
- [SpeeAligner](https://ahos.xyz/work/speealigner): website for a clear aligner lab serving dental clinics, with treatment plans and case submission.
- [Jul's Auto Repair](https://julsauto.com): local service website for an auto repair shop in Raynham, Massachusetts.
- [I Do Taxi](https://ahos.xyz/work/ido-taxi): website and iOS app for Lebanon's 24/7 taxi service, bookable by app, phone or WhatsApp.
- Also: YourProvider (https://www.yourprovider-lb.com), Aleph (https://www.aleph.com.lb), ARIA AI (https://ahos.xyz/aria-ai).

## Frequently asked

- Who owns the code? The client, fully, on delivery. No lock-in.
- How is pricing set? A fixed quote in writing after a free call, paid in milestones. No hourly billing.
- Does AHOS work outside Lebanon? Yes, remotely, with clients in the Gulf, Europe and the US, in English, Arabic and French.
- What happens after launch? A 30-day warranty, then optional care plans for hosting, updates, monitoring and improvements.
